annotation.title_clean: National Program for Artificial Intelligence in Israel: Program and Snapshot – April 2025
annotation.title_en: National Program for Artificial Intelligence in Israel: Program and Snapshot – April 2025
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel Innovation Authority; Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology (Telem National AI Program)
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Israel's multi-year (2021–2026) National Program for AI, budgeted around NIS 1 billion. It reviews the global AI landscape and sets five objectives: infrastructure and talent, high-tech adoption through regulatory sandboxes, public-sector AI, geo-technological standing, and ministry preparedness. It favours innovation-friendly, OECD-aligned regulation. Robotics appears only in passing, and defense is excluded.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five objectives: AI infrastructure, high-tech adoption, public-sector AI, global geo-technological position, national-level preparedness
Regulatory sandboxes to allow experimentation in highly regulated fields
Cross-government regulatory knowledge center, regulators forum and expert advisory group on AI policy
Regulation approach follows OECD AI Principles and Israel's AI Regulation and Ethics policy
Defense-related AI preparations are excluded from the program
